014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016import java.lang.System.Logger;
017
018import java.lang.constant.Constable;
019import java.lang.constant.DynamicConstantDesc;
020import java.lang.constant.MethodHandleDesc;
021
022import java.util.ArrayList;
023import java.util.Collection;
024import java.util.Collections;
025import java.util.Comparator;
026import java.util.HashSet;
027import java.util.List;
028import java.util.Map;
029import java.util.Map.Entry;
030import java.util.Optional;
031import java.util.Set;
032import java.util.StringJoiner;
033
034import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
035import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap;
036
037import java.util.stream.Collector;
038import java.util.stream.Stream;
039
040import org.microbean.constant.Constables;
041
042import static java.lang.System.lineSeparator;
043
044import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.BSM_INVOKE;
045import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.CD_Collection;
046import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.CD_Map;
047
048import static java.util.HashSet.newHashSet;
049
050import static java.util.function.Predicate.not;
051
052import static java.util.stream.Collector.Characteristics.UNORDERED;
053
054import static org.microbean.bean.ConstantDescs.CD_Beans;
055
056public class Beans implements Selectable<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>>, Constable {
057
058  private static final Logger LOGGER = System.getLogger(Beans.class.getName());
059
060  private static final Comparator<Bean<?>> byRankComparator = Comparator
061    .<Bean<?>>comparingInt(Ranked::rank)
062    .reversed();
063
064  private static final Comparator<Bean<?>> byAlternateThenByRankComparator = Comparator
065    .<Bean<?>, Boolean>comparing(Ranked::alternate)
066    .reversed()
067    .thenComparing(byRankComparator);
068
069  private final List<Bean<?>> beans;
070
071  private final ConcurrentMap<BeanSelectionCriteria, List<Bean<?>>> selections;
072
073  public Beans(final Collection<? extends Bean<?>> beans) {
074    this(Map.of(), beans);
075  }
076
077  public Beans(final Map<? extends BeanSelectionCriteria, ? extends List<Bean<?>>> selections,
078                      final Collection<? extends Bean<?>> beans) {
079    super();
080    this.selections = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
081    final ArrayList<Bean<?>> newBeans = new ArrayList<>(31); // 31 == arbitrary
082    final Set<Bean<?>> newBeansSet = newHashSet(31); // 31 == arbitrary
083    if (!selections.isEmpty()) {
084      final Set<Bean<?>> newSelectionSet = newHashSet(7); // 7 == arbitrary
085      for (final Entry<? extends BeanSelectionCriteria, ? extends List<Bean<?>>> e : selections.entrySet()) {
086        final List<Bean<?>> selection = e.getValue();
087        final List<Bean<?>> newSelection = new ArrayList<>(selection.size());
088        for (final Bean<?> b : selection) {
089          if (newSelectionSet.add(b)) {
090            newSelection.add(b);
091          }
092          if (newBeansSet.add(b)) {
093            newBeans.add(b);
094          }
095        }
096        newSelectionSet.clear();
097        if (!newSelection.isEmpty()) {
098          Collections.sort(newSelection, byAlternateThenByRankComparator);
099          this.selections.put(e.getKey(), Collections.unmodifiableList(newSelection));
100        }
101      }
102    }
103    for (final Bean<?> bean : beans) {
104      if (newBeansSet.add(bean)) {
105        newBeans.add(bean);
106      }
107    }
108    newBeansSet.clear();
109    Collections.sort(newBeans, byAlternateThenByRankComparator);
110    newBeans.trimToSize();
111    this.beans = Collections.unmodifiableList(newBeans);
112  }
113
114  @Override // Constable
115  public Optional<DynamicConstantDesc<Beans>> describeConstable() {
116    return Constables.describeConstable(this.selections)
117      .flatMap(selectionsDesc -> Constables.describeConstable(this.list())
118               .map(beansDesc -> DynamicConstantDesc.of(BSM_INVOKE,
119                                                        MethodHandleDesc.ofConstructor(CD_Beans,
120                                                                                       CD_Map,
121                                                                                       CD_Collection),
122                                                        selectionsDesc,
123                                                        beansDesc)));
124  }
125
126  @Override // Beans (Selectable<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>>)
127  public final List<Bean<?>> select(final BeanSelectionCriteria beanSelectionCriteria) {
128    return
129      beanSelectionCriteria == null ?
130      this.list() :
131      this.selections.computeIfAbsent(beanSelectionCriteria, this::computeSelection);
132  }
133
134  private final List<Bean<?>> computeSelection(final BeanSelectionCriteria bsc) {
135    // No need to sort via ranks because the stream will be in encounter order and this.beans has already been properly sorted
136    return this.stream().filter(bsc::selects).toList();
137  }
138
139  public final Stream<Bean<?>> stream() {
140    return this.list().stream();
141  }
142
143  @Override // Beans (Filerable<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>>)
144  public final List<Bean<?>> list() {
145    return this.beans;
146  }
147
148  // Snapshot; slow
149  public final List<Bean<?>> listUsed() {
150    final ArrayList<Bean<?>> used = new ArrayList<>(this.selections.size()); // estimated size
151    final Set<Bean<?>> set = newHashSet(this.selections.size());
152    this.selections.values().forEach(c -> c.forEach(b -> {
153          if (set.add(b)) {
154            used.add(b);
155          }
156        }));
157    set.clear();
158    used.trimToSize();
159    Collections.sort(used, byAlternateThenByRankComparator);
160    return Collections.unmodifiableList(used);
161  }
162
163  // Snapshot; slow
164  public final List<Bean<?>> listUnused() {
165    final Set<Bean<?>> used = newHashSet(this.selections.size());
166    this.selections.values().forEach(c -> c.forEach(b -> used.add(b)));
167    final List<Bean<?>> unused = this.stream().filter(not(used::contains)).toList();
168    used.clear();
169    return unused;
170  }
171
172  // Snapshot
173  public final Set<BeanSelectionCriteria> selectCriteria() {
174    return Collections.unmodifiableSet(this.selections.keySet());
175  }
176
177  // Snapshot
178  public final Set<BeanSelection> selections() {
179    return this.selections.entrySet().stream()
180      .map(e -> new BeanSelection(e.getKey(), e.getValue()))
181      .<Set<BeanSelection>, HashSet<BeanSelection>>collect(Collector.of(HashSet::new,
182                                                                        HashSet::add,
183                                                                        (set0, set1) -> {
184                                                                          set0.addAll(set1);
185                                                                          return set0;
186                                                                        },
187                                                                        Collections::unmodifiableSet,
188                                                                        UNORDERED));
189  }
190
191  @Override
192  public String toString() {
193    final StringJoiner sj = new StringJoiner(lineSeparator());
194    this.list().forEach(b -> sj.add(b.toString()));
195    return sj.toString();
196  }
197
198}
